verdict.rationale: SerpApi's own Brave AI Mode API returns AI-generated search answers with text blocks and references, and its Google AI Mode API scrapes Google AI Mode results, so one call can return a sourced LLM answer. The answers are scraped from third-party engines rather than generated by SerpApi, and the documentation is only a one-line description per endpoint. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the answer and citation response fields, any control over answer generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality and sourcing.
